facts.fact: Nigeria's Head of the Civil Service announced the Federal Government's adoption of the 1Gov cloud ECMS as a single government-wide platform for ministries, departments and agencies, saying it aligns with a national shift to sovereign digitalisation and protects Nigeria's data platforms.

systems.owner: Office of the Head of the Civil Service of the Federation

facts.fact: Galaxy Backbone's managing director's representative said the state company is committed to the optimal performance of the 1Gov cloud ECMS for ministries, departments and agencies, with infrastructure in place and minimal downtime expected.

NGA.note: No data centre, its ownership or tier, or hosting location is stated.
